faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our platform and services.

questions.question: What types of digital assets do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a wide range of digital assets including Excel macros, Python automation scripts, data processing tools, API integrations, and complete business software solutions. All assets are professionally developed, tested, and verified before publication.

questions.question: How does licensing work?
questions.answer: Each purchase includes a commercial license for the number of users specified in your plan. You get lifetime access to the purchased asset, including all future updates. Enterprise plans offer custom licensing options including white-label rights and unlimited user licenses.

questions.question: Can I request a refund if a product does not meet my expectations?
questions.answer: Because our digital assets (open-source Excel macros, Python scripts) and AI Mesh compute are delivered and accessible immediately upon payment, all purchases are final and non-refundable. Refunds apply solely in the event of an unresolvable demonstrable platform defect (see our Refund Policy).

questions.question: Do you provide technical support?
questions.answer: Absolutely. All plans include technical support. Starter plans get email support with 24-48 hour response times. Professional plans get priority 24/7 support. Enterprise plans include dedicated account managers and SLA guarantees.

questions.question: Are the scripts and software secure?
questions.answer: Security is our top priority. All code is reviewed by our security team, follows industry best practices, and includes no malicious code or backdoors. We also provide regular security updates and maintain compliance with industry standards.

questions.question: Can I request custom development or modifications?
questions.answer: Yes! Professional and Enterprise plans include access to custom development services. We can modify existing assets or create completely custom solutions tailored to your specific business needs.

questions.question: How often are products updated?
questions.answer: Products are updated regularly based on user feedback, bug fixes, and new feature additions. Starter plans receive monthly updates, Professional plans get weekly updates, and Enterprise customers can request priority updates as needed.

questions.question: What programming languages and platforms do you support?
questions.answer: We primarily focus on Excel VBA, Python, and JavaScript for automation. Our products support Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. We also offer cloud-based solutions that work across all platforms.

terms.subtitle: Terms and conditions governing the use of the CELAEST platform, AI Mesh orchestration, and digital asset acquisitions.
terms.description: Master service agreement for the CELAEST platform, AI Mesh infrastructure, and digital assets.

sections.title: Subject Matter, Acceptance, and Evidentiary Electronic Consent
sections.summary: CELAEST operates from Colombia with global scope. Account creation and purchases establish binding consent under Law 527 of 1999.
paragraphs: These Terms of Service (hereinafter, the "Terms") govern access to and usage of the web platform, APIs, and enterprise services provided under the CELAEST brand (hereinafter, "the Platform"), operated commercially from the Republic of Colombia with international delivery.

By accessing, registering, or purchasing digital assets or compute on the Platform, Customer declares full understanding and acceptance of these Terms, the Privacy Policy, and the Refund Policy, constituting a legally enforceable contract.

Electronic Evidentiary Consent: Pursuant to Law 527 of 1999 on Data Messages and Electronic Commerce, CELAEST electronically records timestamps, contract versions, IP addresses, and device fingerprints upon registration and checkout, constituting full legal proof of agreement.

sections.title: Service Description and Automated Computing Nature
sections.summary: CELAEST delivers automated digital products and AI Mesh compute. Standard tiers do not include manual consulting or human coaching.
paragraphs: CELAEST is a specialized technological platform providing enterprise workflow automation, open-source VBA Microsoft Excel macros, Python automation scripts, and unified AI Mesh orchestration.

All offerings on the Platform represent automated digital products and compute delivered immediately upon payment. CELAEST does not provide manual human consulting or bespoke human agency execution in standard self-serve tiers; support is delivered asynchronously via AI assistants, technical documentation, and ticket queues.

sections.title: Corporate Accounts, Multi-Account Restrictions, and Security
sections.summary: Credentials are for corporate use only. Credential sharing, multi-accounting to bypass limits, and ban evasion are strictly prohibited.
paragraphs: Access requires authenticated corporate accounts (via email or OAuth providers such as Google or GitHub). Customers must provide accurate, current, and verifiable operational details.

Credentials and API tokens are confidential and non-transferable outside licensed organizations. Sharing, reselling, or leasing account access is prohibited. Entities may maintain only contracted accounts; creating unauthorized auxiliary accounts to evade limits or penalties triggers immediate access suspension via IP and device fingerprint filtering.

sections.title: AI Mesh Orchestration and Data Sovereignty
sections.summary: Customer retains 100% intellectual property ownership of prompts and outputs. Zero-Training guaranteed across 3 tiers.
paragraphs: CELAEST delivers frontier model orchestration grounded in strict Data Sovereignty. Customer retains exclusive intellectual property rights over all input data (prompts, files, code) and generated responses.
Zero-Training Guarantee: No corporate workload or prompt processed through our AI Mesh is ever utilized to train, fine-tune, or reinforce public foundational models.
Our architecture operates across three distinct isolation tiers:
points: Cloud Mesh B2B (Starter & Pro): Ephemeral RAM-based inference across commercial enterprise APIs bound by strict Zero-Training policies guaranteeing your data never trains public models.
BYOK (Bring Your Own Key): Customer connects direct API credentials, governed by direct DPA agreements maintained between Customer and frontier model providers.
On-Premise Sovereign (Enterprise): Models and inferencing executed 100% within Customer's private cloud or air-gapped infrastructure without external internet outbound.

sections.title: Digital Asset Marketplace and Mandatory Sandbox Testing
sections.summary: Commercial license for internal operations. Public redistribution is forbidden, and staging validation is mandatory prior to production.
paragraphs: Acquiring Excel macros or Python automation scripts grants a perpetual, non-exclusive, non-transferable commercial license for internal corporate operations.
Reselling, sublicensing, or posting source code in open public repositories is strictly prohibited.

Mandatory Sandbox Testing: Because every corporate database and operating environment differs, software is provided "as is". Customer bears an affirmative, strict duty to test and validate every script within a staging sandbox environment before running on critical production databases.

sections.title: Plans, Billing, Payment Gateway, and Auto-Renewals
sections.summary: PCI-DSS certified payment processing, global gateways, and direct Colombian rails. Subscriptions renew automatically.
paragraphs: Subscriptions renew automatically at the conclusion of each billing cycle (monthly or annual) using the saved payment method, unless cancelled by Customer prior to the scheduled renewal date. Timely cancellation is Customer's sole duty.

Credit and debit card transactions are processed securely through Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified tokenized payment gateway, or via direct electronic bank transfers in Colombia where available. CELAEST never stores complete credit card numbers or CVV verification codes on its servers.

sections.title: Refund Policy, Cancellation, and Anti-Chargeback Rules
sections.summary: Direct cross-reference to Refund Policy. Final sales, single 10-day technical defect remedy, and statutory withdrawal exceptions.
paragraphs: All rules governing refunds and cancellations are controlled exclusively by the CELAEST Refund Policy, which is incorporated into this agreement by reference.

General Rule: All sales are final and non-refundable. Refunds apply solely upon demonstrable technical defects attributable to CELAEST unresolved after ten (10) business days following a support report to support@celaest.com.

Pursuant to Article 47 of Colombian Law 1480 of 2011, statutory withdrawal is inapplicable to immediately executed digital services. Customer agrees to seek resolution first via official CELAEST support; abusive or fraudulent chargebacks trigger account termination, without prejudice to statutory payment reversion rights under Article 51 of Law 1480 of 2011 for unauthorized fraudulent transactions.

sections.title: Acceptable Use, Anti-Scraping, and Prohibited Conduct
sections.summary: Web scraping, reverse engineering, infrastructure denial, and ban evasion are strictly prohibited.
paragraphs: Customer agrees to utilize the Platform solely for lawful enterprise operational purposes. Prohibited conducts include:
Violations empower CELAEST to suspend access and block corresponding IP addresses and device signatures without refund.
points: Deploying bots, spiders, crawlers, or automated scripts to scrape content or overload infrastructure.
Attempting to decompile, reverse-engineer, or circumvent security validation mechanisms.
Reselling, sublicensing, or distributing software source code to unauthorized third parties.
Initiating unfounded bank chargebacks or payment disputes regarding valid transactions.

sections.title: Service Level Agreement (SLA 99.9%) and Availability
sections.summary: 99.9% uptime target on core infrastructure with dedicated Enterprise SLAs and compensation schedules.
paragraphs: CELAEST maintains a resilient multi-region cloud architecture engineered to deliver at least 99.9% monthly availability on core services.
For Enterprise corporate customers, dedicated Service Level Agreements apply with priority 24/7 engineering support and customized service conditions pursuant to individual master agreements.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability and Indemnification
sections.summary: Provided 'as is'. Consequential damages excluded and aggregate liability capped at fees paid in preceding 6 to 12 months.
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, CELAEST shall not be liable for indirect, punitive, or consequential damages, lost profits, or data corruption arising from script executions without sandbox validation on Customer's systems.

CELAEST's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to this agreement shall not exceed the total fees actually paid by Customer to CELAEST during the six (6) months preceding the incident giving rise to liability.

sections.title: Governing Law, Amicable Settlement, and Jurisdiction (SIC)
sections.summary: Laws of the Republic of Colombia. 30-day amicable negotiation, Colombian courts, and Superintendency of Industry and Commerce.
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia, including Law 1480 of 2011, Law 1581 of 2012, Law 527 of 1999, and Andean Decision 351 of 1993, without prejudice to non-derogable international consumer protections.

Any dispute shall be submitted to good-faith amicable direct negotiation for thirty (30) calendar days. Failing resolution, parties submit to Colombian courts or consumer complaints before the Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC) at www.sic.gov.co.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & AI Mesh
privacy.subtitle: Personal data governance under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013, and binding AI Zero-Training commitments.
privacy.description: How we isolate, govern, and protect your corporate workloads and enterprise data.

sections.title: Data Controller and Guiding Privacy Principles
sections.summary: CELAEST operates as Data Controller under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, with complete alignment with GDPR and CCPA international standards.
paragraphs: CELAEST (hereinafter, "the Platform"), operated commercially from the Republic of Colombia with international scope, acts as Data Controller for personal and corporate data collected via its web applications and APIs.

Our operations strictly comply with Statutory Law 1581 of 2012, Regulatory Decree 1377 of 2013, and concordant Colombian data protection regulations (Habeas Data), alongside compatibility with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
Data Protection Officer (DPO): For regulatory inquiries or exercising statutory rights, contact privacidad@celaest.com.

sections.title: Categories of Data Collected
sections.summary: We collect solely account data, OAuth profile details, transient ephemeral AI workloads, and security device fingerprints.
paragraphs: We collect the following categories of information strictly adhering to necessity and data minimization principles:
Critical Payment Note: CELAEST DOES NOT store full credit or debit card numbers or CVV verification codes. All financial instruments are processed directly by PCI-DSS Level 1 certified gateways.
points: Account and Profile Data: Name, corporate email address, username, and password securely hashed using bcrypt cryptographic algorithms.
OAuth Authentication Data: When signing in via Google or GitHub, we collect solely name, email, and profile avatar. CELAEST never accesses private repositories, contacts, or external source code.
AI Workloads and Code (Prompts and Parameters): Source code and prompts submitted for AI Mesh inference or sandbox validation, processed transiently in active RAM.

Security Data and Device Fingerprinting: IP addresses, user-agents, and technical device fingerprints collected for cybersecurity, fraud prevention, multi-account abuse detection, and electronic evidentiary proof under Law 527 of 1999.

sections.title: Primary and Secondary Processing Purposes
sections.summary: Primary purposes deliver services and establish legal agreements. Secondary purposes cover aggregated anonymous telemetry.
paragraphs: We process personal and corporate data under distinct, transparent purposes:
Data subjects may revoke consent for secondary purposes at any time without impacting contracted core services.
points: Primary Purposes (Indispensable): Account management; AI Mesh model inferencing; script execution in sandboxes; invoice processing and subscriptions; customer support; contractual evidentiary proof and fraud mitigation.
Secondary Purposes: Producing aggregated, anonymous performance metrics to optimize network routing and CDN latency.

sections.title: Strict Binding Commitment to Zero-Training in AI
sections.summary: Customer prompts, proprietary source code, and enterprise files are NEVER used to train or fine-tune public AI models.
paragraphs: CELAEST maintains an unyielding policy of Workload Confidentiality: no prompt, corporate file, or code fragment routed through our AI Mesh is ever utilized to train, fine-tune, or reinforce public foundational models of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex, or third parties.
Unlike mass-market consumer tools, our integrations operate exclusively across commercial B2B APIs with binding Zero-Training commitments, processing workloads ephemerally in active memory.

sections.title: Cookies, JWT Session Tokens, and Local Storage Technologies
sections.summary: JWT tokens for secure authentication and localStorage for UI state. Zero third-party advertising trackers.
paragraphs: JSON Web Tokens (JWT): We utilize JWT tokens to govern session authentication securely, featuring limited expiration windows and automated invalidation upon logout.
Local Storage (localStorage): We employ browser local storage solely to store interface themes (dark/light mode) and temporary editor scratchpad states to prevent code loss.

Web Analytics and Zero Ad-Tracking Policy: We employ Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with IP anonymization to evaluate technical performance and aggregated usage. We do not deploy third-party advertising cookies or trade corporate behavioral data with ad brokers.

sections.title: Infrastructure Subprocessors and International Data Transfers
sections.summary: Global partners audited under SOC 2 and ISO 27001 pursuant to Article 26 of Law 1581 of 2012.
paragraphs: To guarantee high availability, edge security, and ultra-low latency, we partner with world-class subprocessors bound by Data Processing Addenda (DPA):
Pursuant to Article 26 of Law 1581 of 2012, accepting this Privacy Policy constitutes express authorization for international data transfers necessary for platform operation.
points: Cloudflare, Inc. (Perimeter defense, WAF firewalls, DDoS mitigation, and TLS 1.3 certificates).
Vercel, Inc. (Edge serverless hosting and global CDN distribution).
Anthropic PBC / OpenAI LLC / Google Vertex AI (B2B commercial AI inference under non-training agreements).
Isolated Sandbox Environments (Ephemeral code execution and script validation without data persistence).
PCI-DSS Level 1 Payment Processors (Stripe and certified digital payment settlement partners).

sections.title: Data Subject Rights and Formal Habeas Data Procedure
sections.summary: Statutory rights to access, update, suppress, and revoke data. Formal 10-day (+5) statutory timeline and SIC recourse.
paragraphs: Pursuant to Article 8 of Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and concordant regulations, Customer possesses statutory rights to: 1) Access, update, and rectify personal data; 2) Request proof of consent; 3) Be informed of data usage; 4) File complaints before the Colombian Superintendency of Industry and Commerce (SIC); 5) Revoke authorization or request suppression where legally permissible.

Formal Inquiries and Claims: Requests must be submitted in writing to privacidad@celaest.com detailing name, corporate identity, request description, and notification address. CELAEST will formally resolve submissions within ten (10) business days; if extension is necessary, notification will precede with up to five (5) additional business days granted by Article 15 of Law 1581.

sections.title: Information Security, Isolation, and Strong Encryption
sections.summary: TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest, isolated sandboxes, and bcrypt salted password hashing.
paragraphs: We implement defense-in-depth protocols: all external and inter-service communications are encrypted via TLS 1.3 with Perfect Forward Secrecy. Passwords are encrypted utilizing salted cryptographic hashes (bcrypt), rendering plaintext recovery impossible.
Workload Isolation: Script execution takes place within ephemeral, isolated sandboxes, completely separated from core platform infrastructure.

sections.title: Data Retention Schedules and Protection of Minors
sections.summary: Active accounts retained; 30 days for suppression; 5 years for tax records under statutory mandate; 12 months for security fingerprinting.
paragraphs: Account data is retained while commercial relationships remain active. Following verified deletion requests, records are irreversibly purged within thirty (30) calendar days, barring statutory archival duties.

Billing records are preserved for a mandatory minimum of five (5) years pursuant to Colombian tax and commercial legislation (Tax Statute and Code of Commerce). Technical device fingerprints are preserved for up to twelve (12) months for cybersecurity and fraud auditability.
Protection of Minors: CELAEST services are directed exclusively to corporations and persons over eighteen (18) years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors.

cookies.title: Cookie & Tracking Policy
cookies.subtitle: Transparent disclosure of essential technical cookies, session preferences, and anonymous aggregated telemetry.
cookies.description: Technical details regarding local storage and cookies utilized on the CELAEST platform.

sections.title: What are Cookies and Local Storage
sections.summary: Technical identifiers required to maintain secure authentication, CSRF defense, and interface preferences.
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser to remember session and visit telemetry. At CELAEST, we employ them exclusively for security, technical performance, aggregated analytics, and interface personalization.
We enforce a strict Zero Third-Party Advertising Policy: we never sell corporate data to advertising brokers or utilize cross-site tracking cookies for marketing targeting.

sections.title: Categories of Cookies Utilized
sections.summary: We only deploy strictly essential technical cookies and aggregated performance telemetry.
paragraphs: We group our cookies into two distinct categories:
points: Essential Technical Cookies: Indispensable for secure JWT authentication, CSRF mitigation, load balancing, and dashboard session persistence.
Preference Storage: Retains language selections (Spanish / English) and interface themes across visits via localStorage.

Aggregated Technical Analytics (Google Analytics 4): Measures page loading latency, browser types, and aggregated navigation patterns with IP anonymization enabled. You may configure or decline this analytics telemetry via the cookie banner or browser settings.

sections.title: Browser Management and Opt-Out
sections.summary: You hold complete control to clear or block cookies directly from your browser settings.
paragraphs: You can configure your browser to reject or notify you about cookie storage. Please note that disabling essential technical cookies may prevent logging into your account or accessing the management dashboard.
To manage cookies in Chrome, Safari, Edge, or Firefox, navigate to your browser's Privacy & Security settings.

refunds.title: Refund Policy
refunds.subtitle: Commercial terms, final sales on digital software assets, and consumer withdrawal rights under Law 1480 of 2011.
refunds.description: Comprehensive refund, cancellation, and statutory withdrawal policy for the CELAEST platform.

sections.title: Policy Summary and General Rule of Final Sales
sections.summary: Payments for subscriptions and digital assets are final and non-refundable, as they constitute immediate-access digital software and compute.
paragraphs: All payments made for CELAEST subscriptions (Starter, Pro, and Enterprise) and direct digital asset purchases on the Marketplace (open-source VBA Excel macros, Python scripts, AI automation agents, and workflow connectors) are definitive and strictly non-refundable.

CELAEST exclusively commercializes immediate-access digital products and computing services: service delivery begins and digital assets are made available the exact moment transaction confirmation succeeds.

The sole exception is a demonstrable, unresolvable Platform defect as detailed in Section 02. No refunds are granted for subjective dissatisfaction, lack of usage, change of mind, subsequent promotions, or uncancelled recurring subscriptions. This policy forms an integral, legally binding part of our Master Terms of Service.

sections.title: Sole Refund Condition: Demonstrable Platform Defect
sections.summary: Refunds apply exclusively upon verified code defects attributable to CELAEST that substantially impede usage and remain unresolved after 10 business days.
paragraphs: A refund request shall be admitted exclusively when all the following cumulative technical conditions are met:

Upon full technical confirmation of these criteria, CELAEST will refund the purchase price of the defective asset or the pro-rata unused portion of the active subscription period (monthly or annual), calculated from the formal report date to the end of the paid period. Prior periods and consumed compute are strictly non-refundable.

A minor bug, isolated typo, or cosmetic issue that does not substantially prevent core execution does not constitute a platform failure; CELAEST will remediate it via technical update without granting economic refund rights.
points: Customer formally reported the defect via official support channels (support@celaest.com), identifying the affected account, script/macro/API endpoint, and reproduction steps.

CELAEST engineering verified and confirmed that the defect is strictly attributable to the Platform codebase, and not external factors such as client Excel versions, operating systems, network firewalls, corporate antivirus, or third-party client dependencies.
The defect substantially prevents use of the purchased asset or service, and CELAEST failed to resolve or remediate the issue within ten (10) business days following technical confirmation.

sections.title: Non-Refundable Circumstances
sections.summary: Strict exclusions: subjective dissatisfaction, lack of use, change of mind, uncancelled auto-renewals, or customer local environment incompatibilities.
paragraphs: Under no circumstances shall refunds be issued for the following reasons:
Acquiring open-source automation scripts grants immediate, irreversible intellectual property access, precluding post-download buyer's remorse.
points: Subjective dissatisfaction or disagreement with the methodology, architecture, or user experience of the Platform.
Lack of usage, partial usage, uninstallation, or technical unfamiliarity with Python or Excel VBA execution on the Customer's side.
Change of mind or unilateral commercial decisions following purchase or source code download.
Promotions, discounts, coupons, or price modifications introduced after the transaction date (no price matching or retroactive refunds).
Automatic subscription renewals that the Customer failed to cancel prior to the scheduled billing date.
Local device issues, obsolete Excel versions without modern macro support, operating system constraints, corporate group policy restrictions (GPO), or network failures on the Customer's end.
Accounts suspended, penalized, or terminated due to Terms of Service violations (multi-accounting, credential sharing, web scraping, API abuse, or abusive chargebacks).
Purchases executed outside official CELAEST channels or customized Enterprise contracts governed by specific SLAs.

sections.title: Subscription Cancellation vs. Monetary Refund
sections.summary: Cancellation stops future recurring charges while retaining access through the paid cycle. It does not yield a refund for the active cycle.
paragraphs: Canceling a subscription prevents future recurring renewals. It may be executed at any time prior to the renewal date via the Customer profile dashboard or payment gateway customer portal. Access to the AI Mesh and purchased assets remains active through the end of the current billing cycle. Cancellation does not trigger refunds for the in-progress cycle.

Requesting a refund is an extraordinary procedure, governed strictly by Section 02, managed exclusively via CELAEST support. An approved refund immediately terminates access and revokes operational licenses for the refunded asset.

Timely cancellation is the exclusive responsibility of the Customer. While CELAEST may send renewal reminders when technically practicable, the absence of any reminder does not exempt the Customer from timely cancellation obligations.

sections.title: Promotions, Discounts, and Pricing Adjustments
sections.summary: Promotional rates apply strictly to new subscribers and carry no retroactive effect or cash surrender value.
paragraphs: Unless promotion terms explicitly declare otherwise:
Renewal prices respect applicable contractual rates, with any substantial price adjustments notified at least thirty (30) days in advance.
points: Promotional pricing and introductory discounts are valid exclusively for first-time subscribers (entities or persons who have never held a paid account).
Discounts do not apply retroactively and grant no entitlement to price matching or refund of differences on prior purchases.
CELAEST reserves the right to deny promotional rates to entities attempting cancellation and immediate re-subscription to exploit discounted introductory pricing.
Promotional vouchers and coupons are personal, non-transferable, and possess zero cash surrender value.

sections.title: Application Procedure and Prohibition of Abusive Chargebacks
sections.summary: Requests must be addressed to support@celaest.com. Filing a bank chargeback without exhausting support triggers immediate, permanent account ban.
paragraphs: Refund applications are handled exclusively via the CELAEST corporate support desk. There is no automated self-service refund mechanism. Customers must submit requests from their registered corporate email to support@celaest.com.

Submissions must include: 1) Order ID and transaction receipt; 2) Reference to the previously submitted technical bug report; 3) Detailed description and evidence of the 10 business days elapsed without remediation. Incomplete requests will be rejected.

Prohibition of Abusive Chargebacks: Initiating a payment dispute or bank chargeback without exhausting official support channels empowers CELAEST to suspend the offending account and recover collection costs, without prejudice to statutory payment reversion rights under Article 51 of Colombian Law 1480 of 2011 for unauthorized fraudulent transactions.

sections.title: Processing and Financial Settlement Timelines
sections.summary: Refunds executed via the Stripe payment gateway or local bank transfers in Colombia within standard business timeframes.
paragraphs: When legally warranted under Section 02, refunds are executed through the Stripe payment gateway directly back to the original payment instrument.
For transactions completed via direct electronic bank transfers in Colombia, refunds are processed via electronic transfer to the origin bank account following identity verification.
points: Technical engineering evaluation: Up to five (5) business days.
Gateway refund instruction: Immediate upon formal engineering approval.
Bank account credit: Five (5) to ten (10) business days (governed by Customer's financial institution).

sections.title: Consumer Protection and Statutory Right of Withdrawal
sections.summary: Statutory withdrawal exception pursuant to Article 47 of Colombian Law 1480 of 2011 for immediate digital software execution.
paragraphs: The provisions of this policy are without prejudice to mandatory statutory consumer rights under applicable legislation.

In Colombia, the statutory right of withdrawal (derecho de retracto) pursuant to Article 47 of Law 1480 of 2011 may be exercised within five (5) business days following purchase. However, pursuant to paragraph 1 of Article 47, the right of withdrawal is expressly inapplicable to contracts where digital performance commences immediately with the consumer's express agreement.

Given that CELAEST software assets and AI Mesh compute are delivered and activated immediately upon payment authorization, Customer explicitly agrees and consents to immediate performance, perfecting the statutory exception to withdrawal.

sections.title: Subscription Model, Assets, and Immediate Code Delivery
sections.summary: Instant access to the GitHub repository, unlocked Excel VBA macro templates, documented Python scripts, and AI Mesh inference quotas.
paragraphs: Each CELAEST subscription grants tier-based access (Starter, Pro, or Enterprise) to our curated library of enterprise automations, Excel macros with 100% auditable VBA source code, and production-ready Python scripts.

Delivery is immediate: upon payment confirmation through Stripe, access to source code, deployment guides, and monthly multi-provider AI Mesh quotas is provisioned instantly in the customer dashboard without delay.
Active subscribers retain full access to all updates, security patches, and newly released macros and scripts throughout their subscription term.

sections.title: Refund Policy & Immediate Digital Source Code Exception
sections.summary: Payments are final and non-refundable due to the immediate digital delivery and execution of source code assets.
paragraphs: In accordance with Article 47 of Law 1480 of 2011 and international electronic commerce standards, digital goods and services whose performance begins immediately upon express customer consent are exempt from statutory withdrawal and do not qualify for refunds.

The sole admissible exception is a verifiable technical defect attributable exclusively to the Platform that substantially prevents service use and remains unresolved by our support engineering team within ten (10) business days following official submission.
Refunds are strictly denied for lack of usage, change of mind, lack of familiarity with Excel or Python, or renewals not cancelled prior to billing dates.

sections.title: Local Execution, Sandboxing, and Cloud Connectivity
sections.summary: Macros and scripts execute 100% locally on the customer machine or private server once downloaded, ensuring operational sovereignty.
paragraphs: All Excel macros and Python automation scripts are architected to operate fully independently within your local infrastructure or workstation once downloaded, requiring zero continuous server connectivity.

Connection to CELAEST cloud infrastructure is only required when invoking advanced AI Mesh capabilities (such as fallback cascades, embeddings, or dynamic model routing), or when synchronizing updates from the asset marketplace.

sections.title: BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) Integration & API Sovereignty
sections.summary: Customers can link their direct API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, or DeepSeek, billing raw compute directly to their corporate accounts.
paragraphs: The CELAEST architecture supports Bring Your Own Key (BYOK), enabling enterprise teams to connect direct model API credentials and maintain granular control over costs and data processing agreements with LLM vendors.

Credentials are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and are never exposed or shared with third parties. In BYOK mode, token consumption is billed directly by the model provider to your corporate account without intermediary surcharges.

sections.title: Security, Isolation, and Strict Zero-Training Policy
sections.summary: Contractual guarantee that zero prompts, source code, or inference payloads are ever utilized to train public or proprietary models.
paragraphs: We enforce a binding corporate Zero-Training policy: input payloads, prompts, uploaded scripts, and execution outputs are never transferred to third parties for foundational model training or fine-tuning.
All data in transit is protected via TLS 1.3 encryption, and data at rest is isolated by tenant across relational databases (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security enforced via user_id).
For enterprises requiring absolute physical or compliance isolation, the Enterprise plan enables sovereign On-Premise or private VPC (Air-Gapped) deployments.
